teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Sort each dataset in ascending order:
- Linnets ($11$ cyclists): $77, 78, 83, 85, 87, 88, 89, 91, 92, 95, 96$
- Puffins ($11$ cyclists): $68, 70, 72, 73, 76, 79, 81, 84, 85, 88, 92$

Step 2: Set up central stems:
Stems are the tens digits spanning from $6$ to $9$.
- Linnets leaves appear on the left, ordered outwards from the stem (smallest near the stem).
- Puffins leaves appear on the right, ordered outwards from the stem (smallest near the stem).

$$\text{Key: } 8 \mid 7 \mid 0 \text{ means } 78\text{ minutes for Linnets and } 70\text{ minutes for Puffins}$$

hints: For Linnets (n = 11), find the lower and upper quartiles.
walkthrough:
Determine the quartiles for Linnets ($n = 11$):
$$Q_1 = 3\text{rd value} = 83\text{ minutes}, \quad Q_3 = 9\text{th value} = 92\text{ minutes}$$

Compute the interquartile range:
$$\mathrm{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 92 - 83 = 9\text{ minutes}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Identify quartile positions for $n = 11$:
- Lower quartile $Q_1$: $\frac{11 + 1}{4} = 3$rd value in sorted order $\implies Q_1 = 83$ minutes.
- Upper quartile $Q_3$: $\frac{3(11 + 1)}{4} = 9$th value in sorted order $\implies Q_3 = 92$ minutes.

Step 2: Compute IQR:
$$\mathrm{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 92 - 83 = 9\text{ minutes}$$

hints: Compare either average (median) or spread (IQR or range) between the two teams in context.
Linnets median is 88 minutes, while Puffins median is 79 minutes (Linnets took longer on average / Puffins were faster on average).
Alternatively, compare spread: Linnets IQR is 9 minutes (92 - 83), while Puffins IQR is 13 minutes (85 - 72), so Linnets times are less spread out.
walkthrough:
Compare the medians in context:
$$\text{Linnets median } (88\text{ min}) > \text{Puffins median } (79\text{ min})$$
$$\text{On average, Linnets took longer than Puffins (or Puffins were faster than Linnets).}$$

Alternatively, compare the spread in context:
$$\text{Linnets IQR } (9\text{ min}) < \text{Puffins IQR } (13\text{ min})$$
$$\text{The times taken by Linnets were less variable than those taken by Puffins.}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate comparative statistics:
- Medians: Linnets $= 88$ minutes, Puffins $= 79$ minutes.
- Interquartile ranges: Linnets $= 92 - 83 = 9$ minutes; Puffins $= 85 - 72 = 13$ minutes.
- Ranges: Linnets $= 96 - 77 = 19$ minutes; Puffins $= 92 - 68 = 24$ minutes.

Step 2: Formulate one clear comparative statement in context:
Either compare central tendency:
'On average, the Linnets took longer than the Puffins' (or 'Puffins were faster on average than Linnets').
Or compare dispersion:
'The times for the Linnets are less spread out than the times for the Puffins.'
